call_chain: arm_init: gDramBase/gDramSize from /chosen properties are assigned before arm_vm_init
arm_vm_init: pmap_bootstrap sets virtual_space_start=dynamic_memory_begin and kernel_pmap tables; later in the same function early L3 PTE pages are preallocated before returning
arm_init after arm_vm_init returns: tb710fu_ramoops_init then tb710fu_live_log_init (0014)
tb710fu_live_log_init: PE_current_console copies boot framebuffer data; validate geometry and length; ml_io_map(physical,length)
io_map before STARTUP_SUB_KMEM: reserve VA at virtual_space_start; pmap_map_bd(VA,PA,PA+alloc_size,prot)
pmap_map_bd_with_options: require DRAM metadata and uniform is_dram_addr classification across range; write cache-disabled PTEs for arbitrary aligned device PA into preexisting kernel VA PTE slots
video_console initialize_screen later uses ml_io_map_unmappable with its own independently replaceable VA mapping

mapping_conditions.physical_page_alignment: io_map truncates input PA, records offset, and rounds allocation; pmap_map_bd start/end must be page aligned
mapping_conditions.dram_metadata: gDramBase and gDramSize initialized before arm_vm_init; is_dram_addr(addr)=((uint64_t)(addr)-gDramBase)<gDramSize
mapping_conditions.range_classification: all PA pages in one call must have the same DRAM/nonDRAM classification; PA does not have to be in managed span
mapping_conditions.virtual_tables: pmap_pte(kernel_pmap,vaddr) must exist; pmap_map_bd panics if missing
mapping_conditions.startup_phase: live init occurs after arm_vm_init and before KPRINTF initialization, hence early branch before STARTUP_SUB_KMEM
mapping_conditions.platform_variant: Audited non-XNU_MONITOR path uses PTE template directly; no claim made for PPL/SPTM variants
mapping_conditions.hardware: PA width, MMIO/scanout access, actual v_length/offset, and device behavior still need real-device verification

configured_geometry_calculation.status: conditional host calculation from configured 2 GiB memory and recorded 3200x2000 BGRA geometry; not a measurement of current hardware variables
configured_geometry_calculation.classification: all framebuffer pages are below gDramBase and classify nonDRAM; no boundary crossing
calculation_limits: mem_size may be reduced by a nonzero xmaxmem boot argument; runtime mem_size is not read here
LiveXnu maps v_length when nonzero; this calculation assumes v_length equals width*height*4 and offset=0
The allocator budget is shared with any other early IO mappings; this is not a full runtime allocation trace
End alignment adds nonnegative capacity; dynamic_memory_begin absolute alignment is not measured here

historical_note: Old ramoops low-PA comment is preserved as a historical explanation, not treated as a platform API fact. A missing reserve-page reservation is a distinct issue from the ability to create an IO PTE outside managed DRAM.
